changes.comment: Host sessions are now observable end-to-end: onEnded fires exactly once on both handles (subject removal and explicit disposal), handles expose disposed/disposalSignal/Symbol.dispose per the disposal contract, every unusable pasted code rejects with cause-chained TavernPairingError (mesh errors no longer leak across the boundary), failed joins tear down their node, onFailed no longer double-fires, a throwing snapshot read routes through onWarning, and error classes follow the repo template with correct names
